function.name: user_authentication_login
function.description: Authenticates a user based on their username and password. It returns an authentication token if credentials are valid. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

remember_me.description: Whether to keep the user logged in for an extended period.

login_attempts.description: The number of unsuccessful login attempts before displaying a captcha.

message.content: Untuk memeriksa ketersediaan produk, saya perlu memastikan bahwa Anda memiliki akses yang sah. Mohon masukkan nama pengguna dan kata sandi Anda (atau beri tahu saya jika Anda belum memiliki akun). Setelah saya dapatkan token otentikasi, saya akan dapat memeriksa status produk tersebut.
message.reasoning: The user asks in Indonesian: "Apakah produk ini masih ada?" meaning "Is this product still available?" We need to authenticate? The user didn't provide credentials. The system says we can only respond if we have a valid authentication token. So we need to ask for credentials or attempt to authenticate. We can ask user for username and password. According to policy, we should not ask for credentials unless necessary. But we need to authenticate to proceed. So we should ask for credentials. The user hasn't provided them. So we should ask for username and password.
